title: A Silence for the Aftermath
author: Hazel Galloway
blurb: Coral Vasquez, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
